name: Blackthorn Ridge
summary: At Blackthorn Ridge, Razormane quilboar guard the southern Barrens north of Razorfen Kraul. Brine, an orc shaman, watches from a camp above a pool of unusually pure mountain water.

sections.title: A Thorn-Choked Redoubt
sections.body: Beside Razorfen Kraul, Blackthorn Ridge rises through thickets of sharp briars. The Razormane quilboar claim these slopes as ancestral ground. They use the thorn barriers to ambush outsiders and skirmish across the southern Barrens. Travelers still seek the ridge despite the danger, drawn by Brine, a hermit orc shaman. His camp overlooks a spring famed across Kalimdor for its clear, spiritually pure water.

faq.answer: Blackthorn Ridge lies in the far southern Barrens, just north of the briars around Razorfen Kraul and south of Camp Taurajo.
Hostile Razormane quilboar occupy the valley floor. Brine, an orc shaman, lives on a rocky perch above their brambles and watches over the nearby mountain spring.

faq.q: Why is the pool beneath Brine's camp special?
faq.answer: A hidden pool beneath the ridge holds exceptionally pure, clear water, despite the dry plains and the quilboar thornbrakes around it. Shamans use the pool as a sacred focus for their rituals.

angles.text: As a young Horde shaman, you can seek out Brine at the ridge and learn about the purity of natural water elements amid the harsh, dry plains.
Razormane quilboar threaten Horde supply lines through the southern Barrens toward Thousand Needles. Passing caravans must stay vigilant.
